summary.text: Bill Anderson is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 10, which covers Wood County.
He chairs the Energy and Public Works Committee and is an educator.

paragraphs.text: Anderson was born in Parkersburg, West Virginia, on August 9, 1948, and his page lists a B.A. from Marshall University and an M.A. from West Virginia University.
His occupation is listed as educator, and his affiliations include the NEA, the WVEA, American Legion Post 159, the Wood County Farm Bureau and the West Virginia Cattlemen's Association.
His committee assignments are Energy and Public Works (chair), Appropriations, Finance, and Rules.
His interim committees are Energy and Public Works (chair), Finance, and Pensions and Retirement.
